about: Files of the bitfield-packages profile-a-creator-or-topic package (the creator research instruction and profile hand-off), moved here byte for byte from bitfield-packages (commit d926b7adb8ca24159ee64f47e7d9cae254f5b641), under their package paths so they import each other as they did. Nothing here is wired into tool-rows.json: wiring a file is adapting it, in a commit that names this receipt. A file that cannot load or pass here yet is held: its name ends in .held (the same bytes).
